resources.string: Roll the die and walk a life from childhood to the quiet years. Stories and hearts on the way give hearts; at a crossroads, stay for hearts or move on to arrive first. Most hearts at the end wins.
The friends call you to play outside a little longer.
A summer holiday by the river, or start studying early?
A day off with the family, or finish the job first?
A long Sunday lunch, or get on with the week?
Stay one more day in a lovely town, or catch the next train?
An afternoon in the garden, or go and visit everyone?
You learned to ride a bike, and nobody could stop you.
A picnic in the park with the whole family.
Grandma taught you a song you still remember.
Your kite flew so high that you ran after it.
You made a friend for life.
Your first dance at a party.
You passed the exam you studied so hard for.
You missed the bus and walked back to the stop.
Your first pay: a cake for everyone at home.
A colleague helped you through a hard day.
You learned a new trade, and you are good at it.
A traffic jam on the way to work.
A wedding with music and dancing.
Sunday lunch with everyone around the table.
You moved to a house with a garden.
You saw the sea for the first time.
A train ride through the mountains.
Coffee and a chat with old friends.
A tie for the most hearts: %1$s.
